File: testvectors_v1/ecdh_secp256r1_ecpoint_test.json
Original data source recorded in that file: google-wycheproof version 0.9rc5
License: Apache License, Version 2.0 (unmodified upstream LICENSE copied to
WYCHEPROOF-LICENSE.txt).

This project extracts 87 test cases from the pinned 355-case dataset. All 24
invalid cases and the one acceptable compressed-point case are included;
62 valid cases are selected across the upstream edge-case categories. The
private scalar's unsigned integer value is zero-padded to 32 bytes in the Kotlin
fixture. JSON retains the original strings, test IDs, comments and flags.
Expected shared-secret x-coordinates are copied without modification.

The original data remains under Apache-2.0. It is not re-licensed as original
AGPL code. The selection script and test harness are original AGPL-3.0-only
code. The imported JSON source does not contain an individual copyright notice;
this notice preserves project attribution without inventing a copyright year.
